mutations.name: Jcode host applies the requested reasoning effort to its session
mutations.expectRed: requested variant reaches the session as its reasoning effort

mutations.name: Jcode host refuses the launch when the provider rejects the tier
mutations.find: throw jcodeEffortRefusal(error, config.variant, model ?? "(the provider default)");
mutations.expectRed: a tier the provider refuses ends the launch

mutations.name: Jcode host redacts downstream effort rejection text
mutations.find: return `Jcode reasoning effort refused: requested tier ${JSON.stringify(error.requestedTier)}; effective model ${JSON.stringify(error.effectiveModel)}; provider code ${error.providerCode}${ladder}`;

mutations.name: Jcode host retries the mandatory readiness proof after the first-turn MCP snapshot race
mutations.expectRed: a first-turn MCP snapshot race recovers on one bounded retry
